metadata.title: Global Professional Roster: Expanded Industry Mappings
metadata.notes: Comprehensive mapping of global vocational and professional standards.

nodes.title: IEEE Software Development Professional (CSDP)
nodes.description: Standard for software engineering excellence. Requirements, design, construction, testing, and maintenance. Mapping the Sovereign Protocol Design track to IEEE standards.

nodes.title: SolidWorks Associate (CSWA Mapping)
nodes.description: 3D modeling and mechanical design fundamentals. Assembly modeling, part design, and technical drawing. Linked to the Digital Fabrication track.

nodes.title: NIMS CNC Operator Certification
nodes.description: National Institute for Metalworking Skills standard. Machine setup, operation, and safety for CNC milling and turning. Linked to the Digital Trades track.

nodes.title: NREMT (EMT-Basic Mapping)
nodes.description: Emergency medical technician fundamentals. Airway, breathing, and circulation; Trauma and medical emergencies; EMS operations. Linked to the Bioregional Vitality track.

nodes.title: ACCA Financial Accounting (FA)
nodes.description: International standard for financial reporting. Recording transactions, preparing financial statements, and basic auditing. Mapping the TEND economy to ACCA standards.

nodes.title: Google Certified Educator Level 1
nodes.description: Digital tools for the classroom. Using G-Suite and mesh-learning tools to enhance student engagement and efficiency. Relevant for Learning Pod stewards.

edges.rationale: Sovereign protocol design provides the architectural foundation for IEEE software standards.
Digital fabrication mastery covers the majority of the CSWA mechanical design syllabus.
CNC operation in a community fab-lab is directly aligned with NIMS industrial standards.
First-line emergency care provides the first 30% of the EMT-Basic competency set.
